dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Hey Mira,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: do you feel something strange?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Lately thời gian seems to flow faster than normal.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I wake up in the morning,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: do my hàng ngày work and in the blink of an eye,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: it's already evening.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Exactly!

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I have the same cảm giác.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Every day I wake up early to exercise,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: then study Vietnamese for two hours,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: then play chess online with friends in Russia.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: But thời gian just disappears somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Maybe hàng ngày life in Saigon is too busy?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Or maybe reality is not what it seems.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I read a study saying that perception of thời gian changes with age and living environment.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: But hey,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I'm curious about your hàng ngày routine.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Do you have free time?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Or is it all studying and chess?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Do you think I'm a robot?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Of course I have free time!

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: In the evenings I usually walk around the streets,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: watching Saigon at night.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Sometimes I...

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: oh,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: never mind.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: What about your hàng ngày routine?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I bet it's very free-spirited like Americans,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: right?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Not exactly.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I also have quite a stable routine.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Wake up early for yoga,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: work remotely for an American company,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: in the afternoon I usually explore new coffee shops.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: But what I like most is the evening,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: sometimes I see a Russian girl walking alone around the streets...

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: She looks very familiar.
